detail.title: Institutional Research Journal: Autocatalytic Memory Dynamics
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates systematic research into the mechanisms of history-dependent state transitions in autocatalytic reaction networks, focusing on distinguishing between transient hysteresis and functional memory storage. By shifting the research focus to autocatalytic memory—in accordance with active system attention constraints—we establish a framework to analyze how chemical systems encode and retrieve history. Preliminary inquiries investigate the definition of chemical residual channels and the role of state-merging algorithms in interpreting network behavior.
